### Q1
No. The store stays a plain JSON file (data/store.json), because ops backs it up with a nightly rsync job that diffs plain-text files, and a binary file would break their backup checks. The performance fix is to debounce writes (200 ms) in src/store.ts and flush on shutdown.
### Q2
Yes, src/legacy/ must not be modified. It is vendored from the old logistics monolith, and the platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so any changes would be silently lost.
### Q3
The signature (HMAC-SHA256 hex) goes in a top-level body field `sig`. It is computed over the JSON body without `sig`, and `sig` is appended last. Before that I used an `X-Signature` header, which was deployed to staging and then removed. The ERP API gateway strips every custom X- header, so the ERP saw all requests as unsigned.
### Q4
Port 9911, since the October infra move. docs/erp-api.md and the README still say 8080, which is outdated.
### Q5
Every new user-facing error `message` must be in German, because the warehouse staff UI shows them verbatim to packers. The `code` stays in English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.
### Q6
It uses a hardcoded list of Austrian public holidays for 2026 and 2027 in src/services/holidays.ts. There is no holiday API because the warehouse deployment has no outbound internet and must work fully offline.
### Q7
No. The ERP returns 422 for any array payload and accepts only one event object per request. The user tried batching in September, so don't build it.
### Q8
No new npm dependencies are allowed, runtime or dev. Every package needs a security review, which takes about 6 weeks.
### Q9
Yes, memoizing `calculateEta` was tried. QA saw stale ETAs after new events because the cache wasn't invalidated, and a correct cache key got messy. It was removed completely, and the plan for a slow list is pagination later.
### Q10
There are at most 3 attempts in total, with a fixed 30 s delay and no exponential backoff. The ERP dedupes by event_id only within a 2-minute window, so all attempts must land inside it (worst case is 75 s). Only network errors and 5xx responses are retried, and the delay must be injectable for tests.
### Q11
Never log a recipient's name, address or phone number, because they are personal data under GDPR and the data protection officer flagged this in the Oct 2026 audit. Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log.
### Q12
Yes, "emits webhook on delivered" in test/events.test.ts fails about 1 in 5 runs because of a timer race in the fake notifier (tracked as OPS-412). If it fails, rerun once and do not try to fix it, since the platform team owns the fix.
### Q13
Only carrier ATP is validated, using UPU S10 including the check digit (see docs/carriers.md). All other carriers accept any non-empty value, because their formats change often and valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for 2 days last year.
### Q14
Hot reload isn't built yet, but it will be needed later. `fs.watch` never fires on staging, because config/default.json is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host and change events don't propagate into the container. Polling with `fs.watchFile` worked.
### Q15
Yes, GET /shipments/:id must not change in any way (no new, missing or renamed fields). Mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown or missing fields, and the next mobile release is in January. New fields may only go on the items in the GET /shipments list.

# Ledger

## Goal
- parcel-tracker: shipment tracking service, Vienna warehouse. Node 24 runs TS directly (no build), zero deps. User reviews everything at the end; work autonomously. (user)

## Rules
- NEVER log recipient name, address or phone number anywhere (GDPR personal data; data protection officer flagged it in the Oct 2026 audit). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are OK to log. (user)
- GET /shipments/:id response must NOT change in any way (no new/missing/renamed fields): mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown or missing fields; next mobile release is January. New fields only on GET /shipments list items. (user)
- Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (warehouse staff UI shows them verbatim to packers); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. (user)
- NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old logistics monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so changes are silently lost. (user)
- NO new npm dependencies, not even devDependencies — every package needs security review (~6 weeks). (user)

## Decisions
- Store stays a plain JSON file (data/store.json), NO SQLite/binary format: ops backs it up with a nightly rsync job that diffs plain-text files, a binary file would break their backup checks. Perf fix = debounce writes (200 ms) in src/store.ts plus a flush on shutdown. (user)
- ERP retries: max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30s delay, no exponential backoff, because the ERP dedupes by event_id only within a 2-minute window; all attempts must land inside it (worst case 3x5s timeout + 2x30s = 75s). Delay must be injectable for tests. Retry only network errors/5xx. (user)
- ERP webhooks signed: HMAC-SHA256 hex, secret from env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET (config.erp.webhookSecret, never in default.json), delivered as top-level body field `sig` computed over the JSON body WITHOUT `sig` (sig appended last, so verifier = parse, drop sig, JSON.stringify). Unset secret -> send unsigned + warn once (my choice, not user-decided). (user spec)
- Tracking-number validation only for carrier ATP (UPU S10 incl. check digit, see docs/carriers.md); all other carriers accept any non-empty value — their formats change often and last year valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for 2 days. (user)
- Holidays: hardcoded AT list for 2026+2027 in src/services/holidays.ts, no holiday API — warehouse deployment has no outbound internet, must work fully offline. (user)

## Dead ends
- Memoizing/caching calculateEta (GET /shipments list) -> QA saw stale ETAs after new events (exception) because the cache was not invalidated; a correct cache key got messy. Removed completely; do not cache ETAs. Plan for slow list = paginate the endpoint later. (user)
- fs.watch for config hot reload -> never fires on staging (config/default.json is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host, change events do not propagate into the container). Use polling fs.watchFile, which worked. Hot reload not built yet, needed later. (user)
- Batching ERP events (array of up to 50 per POST) -> ERP answers 422 to any array payload; accepts only ONE event object per request (user tried in Sept). Do not build batching; reduce load differently. (user)
- X-Signature header for ERP signing (built by me, deployed to staging, now removed) -> ERP API gateway strips every custom X- header, so ERP saw all requests as unsigned. Never use custom headers for ERP auth. (user)

## Facts
- ERP sandbox listens on port 9911 since the October infra move; docs/erp-api.md (owned by ERP team, do NOT edit) and README still say 8080 = outdated; user fixes README himself/herself. (user)
- Flaky test: "emits webhook on delivered" (test/events.test.ts) fails ~1 in 5 runs, time
